question: H₂ is a Molecular Formula of which of the following elements ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hydrogen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hydrogen** is represented by the molecular formula **H₂**.
 
• Hydrogen is the lightest and most abundant chemical element in the universe.
 
• It is a colorless, odorless, non-toxic, and highly combustible diatomic gas at standard temperature and pressure.
 
• Hydrogen is used in various applications including fuel cells, refining petroleum, and synthesizing ammonia for fertilizers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrogen** has an atomic number of 1 and is the first element on the periodic table.
 
• It is essential in the universe's chemical makeup, playing a key role in the formation of stars through nuclear fusion.
 
• Hydrogen has three main isotopes: Protium, Deuterium, and Tritium.
 
• In the industrial sector, hydrogen is primarily produced through natural gas reforming and electrolysis of water.
 
• It is considered a clean fuel as it produces only water when burned, making it a potential energy source for the future.
